title: Engagement Manager - Enterprise Corporates
description: About Us Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes. 2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler. We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law. Joining Legora means three things. We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions. We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback. We grow together: as a team and with our customers. Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts. If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place. About the Role The way legal work gets done is changing, and Engagement is at the centre of that transformation. We're looking for an Engagement Manager to join our UK & Ireland Engagement team in London, own adoption across a portfolio of enterprise corporate clients and help some of the world's largest in-house legal functions fundamentally change the way they work. This is a role for someone who has led change inside large, complex organisations and knows that real transformation is designed and managed. You will own the adoption and long-term success of strategic enterprise accounts: building deep, multi-level relationships, defining the outcomes and serving as the trusted adviser who turns Legora into an embedded part of how those teams operate. Enterprise means depth: larger, more complex accounts with more revenue at stake. Each account is a global legal function with multiple teams, jurisdictions and business units, its own governance, and a long, multi-phase roadmap. Success depends on navigating that complexity: aligning General Counsel, legal operations, IT, security and procurement, and building momentum one team and one use case at a time until Legora is used across the whole function. At the heart of the role is designing each client's enterprise adoption strategy and delivering the change programmes that transform how they work. For every account you will build a tailored, multi-year roadmap, sequence initiatives from the first pilot teams to function-wide and global adoption, define measurable outcomes and ROI with executive sponsors, and evolve the programme as new AI capabilities and use cases emerge. You will be critical as we continue to build a best-in-class enterprise adoption programme at Legora, helping clients realise measurable ROI, expand successful use cases and transform the way their teams work. What You'll Do You'll lead the post-sale customer experience, owning onboarding, adoption and long-term value realisation for a portfolio of enterprise accounts. Specifically, you will: Design each client's enterprise adoption strategy: the change-management approach, governance model, stakeholder map across legal, business and IT, and target outcomes for how that legal function adopts Legora. Execute against that strategy, sequencing initiatives from the first pilot teams through to function-wide and global adoption across regions, practice areas and business units. Build and run executive governance with each client, including steering committees, executive business reviews and success plans owned jointly with GC and legal operations leadership. Act as a strategic adviser who deeply understands enterprise in-house legal priorities (cost, cycle time, risk, global consistency and doing more without adding headcount), surfaces high-impact opportunities and guides teams towards maximum value from Legora. Navigate the enterprise landscape, including security reviews, IT and integration requirements, procurement and change-control processes, so that adoption keeps moving. Orchestrate engagement from cross-functional teams to accelerate client success (GTM, Product, Legal Engineering, Engineering, Marketing, Support), keeping full account context and coordination. Partner closely with GTM on renewals, expansion and other key commercial moments, building the case for wider deployment and new use cases across the client's organisation. Turn customer feedback into action by working closely with Product, Engineering and Marketing to shape the roadmap, positioning and enablement for enterprise clients. Build reusable enterprise playbooks, governance templates and enablement material from what works, so the whole Engagement team gets better as you go. What You Bring You care deeply about customer outcomes and you know that transformation has to be designed and led. You're proactive, strategic and comfortable steering demanding, senior stakeholders through significant change. You take pride in being the reason customers adopt, grow and succeed. We're looking for: At least 5 years' experience in management consulting, legal, LegalTech or customer success, ideally with enterprise clients in an AI-native B2B vertical. Experience leading large-scale rollouts and adoption programmes at enterprise or global organisations. We want someone who has taken a new way of working into a large, multi-jurisdictional in-house function, navigated procurement, IT, security and sceptical stakeholders, and made it stick. A consulting or transformation background, with a track record of designing and delivering change-management programmes inside large, matrixed organisations. Experience building multi-year, client-level transformation roadmaps and governance structures, and steering them to measurable outcomes. Confidence engaging C-suite and General Counsel-level stakeholders, running executive reviews and building executive sponsorship. Strong programme management: comfortable running complex, multi-workstream programmes with many stakeholders, dependencies and risks. A track record of driving adoption, retention, expansion and satisfaction with enterprise clients. Experience in legal, compliance or other regulated and complex industries, or the ability to learn a complex domain exceptionally fast. Excellent communication skills, written, verbal and interpersonal. You can hold the room with a General Counsel and roll up your sleeves with the teams who use the product every day. High EQ: you know when to listen, when to advise and when to act. A love of fast-paced, early-stage environments where you help build the playbook, not just follow it. Fluency with metrics, and a focus on data, customer health and outcomes over process. Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. description: Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe! Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy. We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide. It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone. Kraken is building the next generation of AI technologies for the energy sector, and we're looking for an exceptional Head of Applied Research to help lead that ambition. As the advanced technology platform powering some of the world's largest energy utilities, Kraken has a unique combination of deep energy domain expertise along with technological rigor in AI and optimisation, offering a unique opportunity to develop AI technologies that shape how energy systems operate. Kraken has been investing in the development of energy-specific AI models and intelligent decision-making systems to power products that can understand, predict and ultimately help shape how energy is consumed, managed and distributed. This isn't a traditional research lab. Our focus is on building technically ambitious, commercially valuable AI systems that solve real-world problems. We want to push the boundaries of what's technically possible while ensuring that the technology we develop translates into meaningful products, measurable impact and lasting competitive advantage. Reporting into and working closely with our Chief AI Officer, you'll help define Kraken's applied research strategy, establish the technical foundations for our next generation products and cultivate an exceptional team capable of delivering them. Stay at the forefront literature, developments inAI research, identifying emerging capabilities that could transform software products that underpin the energy industry. Support technical assessments of potential AI partnerships and acquisitions, helping inform build, buy and partner decisions. 🧠 What you’ll bring to the party We're looking for an exceptional technical leader who has demonstrated the ability to develop advanced AI technology and turn it into real-world impact. Essential experience Deep expertise in modern machine learning and deep learning, with a strong understanding of foundation models, model architectures, and data pipelines. A proven track record of designing, developing or leading the creation of advanced AI models that have delivered measurable technical or commercial outcomes. Strong technical knowledge of several areas such as transformer architectures, foundation-model training and adaptation, representation learning, time-series modelling, reinforcement learning and related machine learning techniques. Experience working with large, complex datasets and developing models capable of identifying meaningful patterns, generalising across problems and operating at scale. A strong understanding of the end-to-end model development lifecycle, including data preparation, training, evaluation, experimentation, inference and production deployment. This involves an office-first setup</p> <p>🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced</p> <p>🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success</p> <p>🏖️ Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave, plus bank holidays and special leaves</p> <p>🏥 Health matters: private health insurance, including optical and dental</p> <p>🚗 Life made easier: salary-sacrifice commuter benefits via Gogeta</p> <p>💼 Financial security: retirement scheme (SumUp matches 7% when you contribute 5%)</p> <p>🛡️ Peace of mind: life insurance from MetLife for 2× your salary</p> <p>🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service</p> <p>🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team</p> <p> </p> <h2>About SumUp</h2> <p>Be empowered to do more that matters.</p> <p>At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. title: Senior Data Scientist
description: <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/bY0nNPT75xY" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p> <p><strong>Senior Data Scientist | Autoplanner | Hybrid Working | London</strong></p> <p><strong>Introduction:</strong> </p> <p>We are Ocado Group, and we're bringing world-class automation to online grocery. Our Ocado Smart Platform (OSP) combines cutting-edge robotics, AI, and IoT within our advanced CFCs (Customer Fulfilment Centres). We've mastered the single pick, transforming online delivery for our global partners. Join us and be part of a team pushing the boundaries of retail technology.</p> <p><strong>About the Role:</strong></p> <p>As a Senior Data Scientist within our Autoplanner team, you will build AI-powered systems that unify planning across global warehouses and last-mile operations. You will be responsible for developing the machine learning models, optimisation algorithms, and operational simulations that underpin our core planning products. By taking high-impact models from concept through to monitored production systems, you will ensure automated operational plans are robust, globally optimised, and trusted to run live across our partners' international supply chains.</p> <p>Working closely with cross-functional software engineers and product managers, you will set the technical direction for key initiatives while mentoring colleagues to elevate the team’s overall data science capabilities. You will also engage directly with internal and external stakeholders, including global retail partners - to translate complex logistics challenges into production-ready data science solutions, shaping the future of autonomous operational planning.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Deliver machine learning models for planning products, iterating from initial prototype to evaluated and monitored production artefacts.</li> <li>Explore innovative modelling and optimisation approaches, benchmarking and testing them rigorously against existing solutions.</li> <li>Build and extend simulations of warehouse operations and customer demand to validate and power live operational plans.</li> <li>Define and measure business-critical metrics using robust statistical techniques, establishing the team's standards for model evaluation.</li> <li>Set the technical direction and delivery strategy for the data science initiatives you lead.</li> <li>Develop the technical capabilities of data scientists across the team through mentoring, technical guidance, and collaboration.</li> <li>Partner with software engineers to ensure models are cleanly packaged, deployed, monitored, and efficiently served on the platform.</li> <li>Own relationships with product managers, internal partner teams, and external retailers to align on requirements and delivery roadmaps.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We’re Looking For: </strong><em>Essential</em></p> <ul> <li>Proven track record of taking data science and machine learning models into production, maintaining them, and leading initiatives end-to-end.</li> <li>Strong machine learning and statistical expertise, including the ability to evaluate model performance rigorously against business metrics.</li> <li>Fluency in writing production-quality Python code.</li> <li>Experience querying and working with large datasets in cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery, including implementing data-quality checks.</li> <li>Experience building simulations or stochastic models of operational systems.</li> <li>Practical experience using AI coding agents, alongside the critical judgement to verify and test generated code and outputs.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with software engineers, product managers, and diverse business stakeholders.</li> </ul> <p><em>Nice to Haves</em></p> <ul> <li>Experience with mathematical optimisation frameworks and toolkits, such as OR-Tools.</li> <li>Experience with discrete-event simulation libraries, such as SimPy.</li> <li>Background or domain knowledge in logistics, supply chain, or operational research.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Benefits</strong> </p> <p>We believe in supporting our people with meaningful, flexible benefits that prioritise well-being and work-life balance. Here’s a snapshot of what you can expect:</p> <ul> <li>Time to recharge: 25 days annual leave (rising to 27 after 5 years), plus the option to buy more – and 30 days a year to work from anywhere in the world.</li> <li>Health & wellbeing: Private Medical Insurance from your first month, wellbeing support through specialist apps and EAP, plus Income Protection and Life Assurance.</li> <li>Family-first policies: 22 weeks paid maternity/primary carer leave and 6 weeks paid paternity leave</li> <li>Financial support: Pension with employer matching up to 7%, share schemes (Sharesave & BAYE), and interest-free loans for train tickets.</li> <li>Commuter perks: Cycle to Work Scheme and free shuttle buses to/from Hatfield and Welwyn Garden City stations.</li> <li>Exclusive discounts: 15% off at Ocado.com with free delivery (starting in your first month).</li> </ul> <p>Be bold, be unique, be brilliant, be you. We are looking for individuality and we value diversity. We are an equal opportunities employer and we are committed to treating all applicants and employees fairly and equally. We are committed to making reasonable adjustments to provide a positive, barrier-free recruitment process and supportive work environment. If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at the time of application.</p> <p>#LI-HYBRID</p> <p>#LI-JT1</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Hardware Engineer, FPGA
description: Normal Computing | Build with Us Normal is an applied AI company solving the hardest problems in AI and silicon. We build foundational hardware and software for the semiconductor industry, critical AI infrastructure, and the broader systems that power our world, in partnership with the world's most advanced institutions. We work as one team across New York City, Silicon Valley (Mountain View), and London. The Role Validating conventional silicon is a solved discipline. Validating silicon that computes with noise is not, and you will be the one who figures out how. As our FPGA Design Engineer, you will own the bridge between RTL and physical silicon: bringing our physics-inspired ASIC designs to life on FPGA platforms for pre-silicon validation and early software development, and building the test infrastructure for post-silicon bring-up and characterization. Your scope spans the entire FPGA lifecycle: selecting hardware platforms, implementing complex RTL, debugging in the lab, and writing the software that drives it all, working daily with our silicon, EDA, and research teams. What You Will Own FPGA Platform Ownership : Lead the selection, procurement, and bring-up of FPGA prototyping platforms (e.g., HAPS, VCU118/VPK180-class boards, or custom hardware) for pre-silicon RTL validation and software development. RTL Implementation : Adapt and implement complex ASIC RTL onto FPGA targets, including multi-clock-domain architectures, CDC bridges, and timing closure on dense designs. IP Integration : Integrate in-house designs with third-party and vendor IP; serve as the expert on the AMD/Xilinx ecosystem (Vivado IP Integrator, transceivers, memory controllers). High-Speed Interfaces : Design, implement, and validate high-speed I/O with a focus on PCIe: our accelerators ship as PCIe cards in standard servers. Post-Silicon Validation : Build FPGA-based "tester" designs for silicon bring-up, device characterization, and automated test environments. Hardware-Software Stack : Develop the software layer around the hardware: Python/C++ hardware abstraction, register-map generation, and automated build and regression flows. Lab Debug : Root-cause complex timing and functional issues in real time using ILA/Vivado Analyzer, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and BER/eye-diagram characterization of high-speed links. What Makes You a Great Fit Proven industry experience taking FPGA designs from RTL through timing closure to validated hardware, ideally in an ASIC prototyping, emulation, or high-growth hardware environment. Expert-level SystemVerilog and/or VHDL for synthesis, with deep proficiency in Xilinx Vivado (synthesis, place & route, timing closure, IP catalog). Hands-on experience implementing and debugging PCIe, plus AXI/AHB, SPI, UART, JTAG, and other common interfaces. Strong Python for automation, test, and build tooling. Strong board-level bring-up and lab debugging skills on real hardware. Startup mindset: you work independently, pivot quickly, and run at ambiguous problems that span hardware, software, and physics. Bonus Points Verification frameworks like Cocotb or UVM Experience deploying ML models to FPGAs (hls4ml, FINN, or custom NN-to-RTL flows), or building real-time, sub-microsecond signal processing pipelines. Mixed-signal ASIC exposure: digital front-ends, ADC/DAC interfaces, or analog compute. SERDES tuning and signal integrity fundamentals. CI/CD for hardware (GitLab CI, Docker-based build and test). Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence. Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx. What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates. What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure. If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next. How we work We're in the middle of a deliberate shift in how hx builds. Everyone in product development is a Builder , and the Product Engineer is the default unit of how we work. We organise around problems, not permanent teams. Small pods , usually of two to four Product Engineers, form around the highest-value problem, own it end-to-end from discovery through to running it in production, and re-form as priorities change. Pods sit inside value streams, each owning a customer outcome and led by a Stream Lead who decides which problems the stream takes on and holds the bar for what ships. Your growth sits elsewhere: a Career Mentor owns your development and progression, so you can move to where the most important problem is without your career following the org chart. We hire Product Engineers into hx, not into a fixed team, domain, or layer of the stack. You'll start in the stream where your strengths and our highest-value problems meet, and move as the problems move. Product Engineers are T-shaped: deep expertise in software engineering, plus enough product and design judgement to make routine calls yourself. An embedded PM or designer raises a pod's ceiling on the hardest problems, but is never a gate between you and the customer. This is also a deliberately AI-native role, and one of the areas where we're moving fastest. A pod of three owns its problem whole, which means going wherever it leads: front end, back end, data, or infrastructure. You don't need to be full-stack by trade, but you do need to be comfortable working outside your strongest layer. The Product Engineer role is the same at every level. What scales is the size of the problem you own, how expensive your decisions are to reverse, and how far your judgement travels beyond your pod. At Level 2 , that looks like this: What you'll be doing Taking a customer problem from discovery to production inside a pod, getting close to customers yourself, framing the problem, and shipping in small increments guided by real customer signal rather than internal opinion. Directing AI agents to draft implementation, tests, and migrations, then reviewing, integrating, and hardening that work. You'll write intent precisely enough to brief both a teammate and an agent, and own correctness and maintainability regardless of how the first draft was produced. Designing and delivering robust production systems where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency matter, with the tests and observability that make complex behaviour safe to evolve. Working across the codebase wherever the problem leads, including areas your pod doesn't steward, with stewards looped in proportionate to the risk rather than handing work off and waiting. Moving between pods, problems, and streams as priorities change, ramping fast on unfamiliar domains and leaving what you built running well behind you. Taking full accountability for outcomes rather than just your code changes: raising risks early, and deciding rather than escalating. What you'll need to have done Built and shipped production systems end-to-end, from design through rollout, monitoring, and iteration, in settings where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency mattered. Designed testing and observability that made complex behaviour understandable, debuggable, and safe to evolve. Worked effectively in a polyglot environment, choosing the right tool for the problem and picking up unfamiliar languages, domains, and codebases fast. Strong systems experience, for example in Rust, C/C++, or Python, is valued, and we'll upskill you where there are gaps. Shipped work outside your strongest layer of the stack when the problem needed it, picking up the front end, the data layer, or the infrastructure rather than waiting for someone else to. Used AI tools as a serious part of how you build, with the judgement to direct, review, and stand behind what they produce. Carried product and design judgement into your engineering work, shaping the solution rather than only implementing a spec and making sensible calls under ambiguity. Owned outcomes beyond your immediate task, taking decisions rather than escalating them. You’re unlikely to thrive here if You prefer following detailed instructions rather than experimenting and finding your own approach. You are uncomfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders to understand their challenges. You avoid tackling ambiguous or open-ended problems where the solution isn’t obvious. If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us. Compensation At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally. Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make. Benefits £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development. 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total). Company pension scheme via Penfold. Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life . Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno. Private healthcare insurance through AXA. Income protection and Life Insurance. Interview process Initial chat with our Talent team Lead Hirer Interview Live AI Skills Assessment Values Interview with the CPTO Meet the CEO Our commitment to Diversity hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive. Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure. If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team. Next steps If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome. title: Head of Technical Support
description: 📍 London (Hybrid — 2 days onsite) 🕒 Permanent | Start ASAP We’re Making Travel Effortless. Join Us. Travel is essential, whether it’s visiting family, starting a new adventure, or taking a career defining trip. Yet today, over 4 billion airline passengers rely on tech that hasn't changed in decades. At Duffel, we’re rebuilding the infrastructure underpinning the global travel industry. Backed by top-tier investors (Benchmark, Blossom, Index Ventures, and Kima Ventures) and born out of Y Combinator (S18), we’re simplifying complex systems to build the future of travel About the role As Head of Technical Support, you’ll lead our team of Technical Support Engineers and take responsibility for the quality, effectiveness and development of the function. You’ll build a team that combines strong technical investigation with clear, thoughtful customer communication. You’ll coach engineers, establish effective ways of working and ensure customers receive dependable support as their integrations grow in complexity and scale. You’ll stay close to the work: reviewing investigations, helping with significant escalations and understanding where our products or processes create friction. Your impact will come from strengthening the whole team’s ability to resolve problems and turning what we learn from support into lasting improvements. You’ll work closely with Engineering, Product, Partner Engineering, Partner Management and Travel Operations. Technical Support owns day-to-day API questions, troubleshooting and the customer support response to technical incidents. Partner Engineers own strategic technical relationships and solution architecture; Implementation Managers own implementation programmes. What you’ll do Lead and develop the team. Set clear expectations, provide regular coaching and feedback, support career development and address performance issues constructively. Hire and onboard engineers as the team grows. Own support quality. Establish standards for technical investigation, written communication, case ownership and follow-through. Ensure customers understand what is happening, what comes next and who is responsible. Build a dependable support operation. Improve triage, prioritisation, queue management, handovers and escalation paths. Plan staffing and coverage around customer needs and agreed service commitments, with a sustainable workload for the team. Strengthen technical capability. Help engineers investigate API behaviour, interpret logs and request traces, reproduce integration issues and distinguish customer configuration problems from platform or supplier issues. Lead significant customer escalations. Coordinate the support response, establish customer impact and keep communication clear through to resolution. Work with Engineering on diagnosis and recovery, involving Partner Engineering where an issue creates a wider strategic risk. Make collaboration effective. Give Engineering actionable escalation reports with evidence, reproduction steps and impact. Work with Travel Operations on booking and supplier issues, and with implementation teams to ensure new integrations enter support with the context the team needs. Improve the product through support. Identify recurring problems and turn them into clear recommendations for Product and Engineering. Track whether fixes, documentation and product changes actually reduce customer friction. Make support easier to deliver. Develop troubleshooting guides, internal knowledge, customer documentation and useful tooling. Apply automation and AI where they improve accuracy, speed and access to help. Use evidence to guide decisions. Monitor response and resolution performance, ageing work, reopened cases, customer feedback and team capacity. Use that information to prioritise improvements and make clear recommendations about investment. What we’re looking for Experience managing and developing a technical support or support engineering team serving business customers. A track record of improving both customer outcomes and how a support function operates. Strong technical understanding of APIs, HTTP, authentication, webhooks and integrations, with enough practical depth to guide investigations and earn the trust of engineers. Comfort working with logs, SQL and scripts to investigate problems or improve support workflows. Experience handling consequential customer escalations, including situations where the cause or resolution is initially uncertain. Ability to explain technical issues to developers, business stakeholders and senior leaders. Sound judgement about urgency, customer impact and competing priorities. Evidence of effective hiring, coaching, performance management and delegation. The ability to influence Product, Engineering and commercial teams through clear reasoning and useful evidence. Comfort building and improving a function in a growing company, while remaining involved in its day-to-day work. Experience that would be useful Supporting an API platform, developer product or infrastructure business. Working with enterprise customers running important production integrations. Leading support across different time zones. Improving support tooling, knowledge management, self-service or automation. Experience in travel technology, payments or another industry with complex external dependencies. You don’t need to have worked in travel or held this exact title. We’re interested in the teams you’ve developed, the problems you’ve solved and the judgement you bring. What success looks like During your first six months: Engineers have clear expectations, regular coaching and practical development plans. Customer issues have clear ownership, appropriate prioritisation and dependable communication. You have established a trustworthy baseline for support performance and delivered measurable improvements in the most important areas. Escalations reach the right teams with better evidence and fewer unnecessary handovers. Recurring problems are being addressed through product changes, documentation or tooling. Duffel has a clear plan for the support capacity and capabilities needed as the business grows. Why You’ll Love Working at Duffel We believe in true ownership. That’s why every permanent employee gets equity in the business. Perks That Actually Matter: ✈️ Travel Allowance: We literally pay you to get out of town and explore the world. 🏝️ Work From Anywhere: Flexibility is built in. Work remotely, or take advantage of our Sabbatical Policy . ⚡ Electric Car Scheme: Roll up in a brand-new EV with eco-friendly tax savings. ⚖️ Work-Life Harmony: Flexible bank holidays, generous family leave, and a dedicated volunteering day. 📚 Growth Tools: Paid study days to level up your skills, plus a solid pension and cycle-to-work scheme. 🏥 Health & Wellbeing: Private healthcare, eye test cover, and season ticket loans. 🏡 Family Leave (maternity, paternity and adoption): Big support for life’s biggest moments, 26 weeks fully paid. The Details 📍 Location: Shoreditch, London (Hybrid: In-office Tuesdays & Thursdays). 🧠 Interview Process: Simple & transparent: (change accordingly to role) Recruiter Screen Hiring Manager Chat Technical Case Study Final Stage Interview. We are an equal opportunities employer. We believe that the key to our success is employing a diverse team, that's why recruitment decisions are only based on your experience and skills. We value your ability to problem solve and build amazing things so we welcome applications for everyone - regardless of age, sex, disability, sexual orientation, race, religion or belief. Note to recruitment agencies Duffel does not accept speculative CV's from external parties. Any unsolicited CV's sent to us will be treated as property of Duffel, and any attached terms and conditions associated with these CV's will be null and void. title: Senior / Staff Product Manager
description: V7 At V7, we’re building AI platforms that help humans do their best work, at incredible scale and speed. Our mission is to turn human knowledge into trustworthy AI, making complex tasks faster, smarter, and more accurate. We’re growing fast, backed by leading investors and AI pioneers (including the minds behind Transformers and Gemini). The product V7 Go helps teams turn complex, repeatable work into AI workflows they can run, review and improve . Built for private markets, insurance and real estate, it supports investment diligence, underwriting, claims review and portfolio reporting—from analysing documents and data to generating deliverables and updating connected systems. Your experts define how the work should be done. V7 combines reusable Skills, shared company knowledge and configurable workflows, with citations, audit logs and human review to help teams verify results and control key decisions. It supports models including GPT, Claude and Gemini. Build workflows around your processes. Configure each stage, choose models and tools, and set review steps where human judgement matters. Teams can inspect sources, correct outputs and refine workflows over time. Explore workflows . Give every workflow your firm’s knowledge. The Context Graph connects documents, entities, relationships and source evidence, creating institutional memory that teams and agents can draw on. Turn analysis into work your team can use. Generate editable memos, reports, presentations and spreadsheets, and connect workflows to the tools your business already uses. Explore document generation . Have a look at what we’re building for finance and insurance . The team you’ll be joining and the impact you’ll have You’ll own V7 Go. That’s the whole product, not a corner of it, working with engineers, designers and with the founders close by. title: Head of Talent Acquisition, International
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.</p></div><p><strong>ABOUT THE JOB</strong></p> <p>As the Head of Talent Acquisition, EMEA, you own the build-out of Anduril's talent acquisition capability across<br>the EMEA region. Reporting to the Senior Director of Talent Acquisition and partnering closely with the Head of<br>Strategic Planning for Talent Acquisition, you are a key member of the TA Leadership team with a specific<br>mandate: geo-specific scaling. You own the in-country, site-specific, and division-specific hiring build-out across<br>EMEA, working in close partnership with the Head of Talent Acquisition, APAC and with each Divisional Head of<br>TA who is adding headcount into your region.</p> <p>This is not a divisional leadership seat. You are not embedded in any single business unit's leadership team; you<br>are the connective tissue across all of them for one geography. Multiple divisions will be scaling into EMEA at<br>once, often into the same countries and talent pools, and your job is to make sure their combined demand lands<br>on a coherent, compliant, and well-resourced regional hiring capability, rather than five uncoordinated efforts<br>competing for the same candidates.</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL DO</strong></p> <p><strong>Regional Strategy and Build-Out</strong><br>• Define and execute Anduril's EMEA talent acquisition strategy, directly informed by the combined hiring<br>demand of every division scaling into the region.<br>• Own EMEA hiring outcomes (time-to-fill, quality, acceptance rates) as the single accountable owner for<br>regional delivery.<br>• Own EMEA hiring governance, compliance, and workforce planning across the region's countries, each with<br>distinct labor law, works council, and candidate market dynamics.<br>• Develop EMEA hiring playbooks, and partner with the Head of Talent Acquisition, APAC to share what's<br>working across both regions rather than each building in isolation.<br>• Partner with the Head of Strategic Planning for Talent Acquisition to evaluate where EMEA needs additional<br>in-country or sub-regional leadership as demand grows (e.g., a dedicated UK or Germany lead), and help<br>build the case and the structure for it.<br><br><strong>Cross-Divisional Partnership and Prioritization</strong><br><strong>• </strong>Serve as the senior talent advisor to EMEA-based business leaders and to every Divisional Head of TA adding<br>headcount into the region, synthesizing what could otherwise be five disconnected divisional views into one<br>coherent regional talent picture.<br>• Partner with in-region recruiting resources and EMEA business leaders to ensure the regional model reflects<br>on-the-ground reality, not just headquarters assumptions.<br>• Act as the tie-breaker when multiple divisions' hiring demand converges on the same country, site, or talent<br>pool with more need than the region can serve at once, using an objective, business-impact-driven<br>framework.<br>• Drive continuous improvement through data and feedback loops, standardizing what should be consistent<br>across EMEA while preserving the flexibility each country and division genuinely needs.</p> <p><strong>Operational Cohesion with Peer Regions</strong><br><strong>•</strong> Partner closely with the Head of Strategic Planning for Talent Acquisition, a peer, not a manager, who is<br>accountable for cross-regional cohesion, shared playbooks, and consistency of operating rhythm across<br>EMEA and APAC.<br>• Loop in the Head of Strategic Planning early on build-out choices (tooling, process, governance) so that<br>EMEA and APAC remain coherent for divisions scaling into both regions.<br>• Resolve cross-regional alignment issues collaboratively, escalating to the Senior Director of Talent<br>Acquisition only when peer alignment can't be reached.</p> <p><strong>REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS</strong><br><strong>•</strong> 10+ years of progressive TA experience, including demonstrated success building or scaling EMEA hiring<br>specifically, not just supporting it from a distance.<br>• Deep understanding of EMEA labor markets, employment law, works councils, and compliance<br>considerations across the region's key countries.<br>• Proven experience designing and executing an end-to-end regional talent acquisition strategy.<br>• Demonstrated ability to lead and influence across a matrixed structure, partnering with multiple Divisional<br>Heads of TA and business leaders who do not report to you.<br>• Strong track record of driving continuous improvement through data-driven decision making, with the ability<br>to report regional hiring outcomes credibly to Global TA Leadership.<br>• Exceptional communication and influencing skills, with the ability to reconcile competing divisional demand<br>for the same regional capacity and drive consensus without formal authority.</p> <p><strong>PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS</strong></p> <p>perience partnering with or building out in-country resources as part of a broader regional build.</p> <p class="p1">• Experience building a regional operating model that other regions (e.g., APAC) have adapted or could adapt.</p> <p class="p1">• Prior experience as part of a broader transition from a U.S.-led to a localized, globally scalable TA model.</p> <p class="p1">• Experience in defense, aerospace, or other hardware and software-intensive industries.</p> <p class="p1">• A background in or strong familiarity with BizOps, program management, or business strategy.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span data-contrast="auto">The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335551550":0,"335551620":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240}"> </span></p> <p> </p> <h3 class="detailElios"><strong>Benefits</strong></h3> <p><span data-contrast="auto">At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. </span><em><span data-contrast="auto">For more information, <a href="https://www.anduril.com/careers">Explore Our Benefits</a>.</span></em></p> <p> </p> <div class="RichText column1"> <h3 class="detailElios"><strong>Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams</strong></h3> <p class="detailElios">Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.</p> <p>Certified as a <em>Great Place to Work </em>around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the <em>Financial Times </em>in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by <em>Forbes </em>for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.</p></div><h3><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Baringa is looking for talented 2027 Summer Interns to join our Solutions & AI Lab team.</span></span></h3> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Our Internship</span></span></h3> <p>Our eight week Summer Internship Programme is designed to give you hands-on experience, meaningful responsibility, and a true insight into life at Baringa. Over the course of the programme, you’ll work alongside experienced consultants and specialists on real projects, develop valuable skills through tailored learning opportunities, and build connections across the business. Whether you’re exploring your career options or looking to kick-start your professional journey, our internship offers a supportive environment where you can learn, grow, and make an impact.</p> <h3><span style="color: #00358e;">What's in it for you?</span></h3> <p>Well, it’s up to you. Baringa is what you make it.</p> <p>Our Summer Internship Programme is designed to help you build your skills, expand your network, and gain first-hand experience of consulting. As well as making a meaningful contribution from day one, you'll have the chance to explore future career opportunities at Baringa, including the opportunity to be considered for a permanent Analyst role after graduation.</p> <p>Our Summer Internship opportunities are available across a range of our Capability business units. Explore the summaries below to learn more about each team and discover where your skills and interests could make an impact. You can also find additional information about each team on our website.</p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">About our Solutions & AI Lab Team:</span></span></h3> <p>Our Solutions & AI Labs (SAIL) practice focuses on helping clients control their data, turn them into actionable insights and better leverage them through the use of Machine Learning solutions directly embedded into business processes. We support clients across a number of industries and offer deep expertise in AI, ML, Cloud and Managed Solutions. We are seeking passionate and dynamic ML engineers who are excited by building production Machine Learning solutions.</p> <p><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none"><em>Desirable skills & degrees: <span data-teams="true">A degree in a STEM related field is required, but degrees in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics and Engineering are preferred.</span></em></span></span></p> <h3><span style="color: #00358e;">Requirements</span></h3> <ul> <li>Applicants should be graduating in 2028 and be in the penultimate year of their bachelor’s or master’s Degree studies.</li> <li>Applicants must have the permanent right to work in the UK now and in the future. All applicants will be asked for proof if invited to an assessment centre. Please note<em> we’re unable to sponsor individuals for this opportunity.</em></li> </ul> <p> Any questions surrounding this please contact us at <a ---------- <h3><span style="color: #00358e;">Key dates</span></h3> <p>Assessment centres: January 2027<br>Internship start: Monday 5<sup>th</sup> July 2027<br>Internship end: Friday 27<sup>th</sup> August 2027</p> <p><em>This is a paid full-time internship.</em></p> <p>For further information, please read our <a href="https://www.baringa.com/globalassets/careers/graduate/pdfs-and-downloads/global-summer-internship-pack-2026.pdf">Summer Internship 2027 pack</a></p> <p> </p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What a career at Baringa will give you</span> </span></h3> <h3><span data-contrast="none"><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);">Putting</span> </span><span data-contrast="none"><span style="color: rgb(208, 0, 111);">People</span> </span><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">First.</span> </span></h3> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);" data-contrast="none">Diversity and Inclusion</span></h3> <p><span data-contrast="none">We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people.</span> </p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);" data-contrast="none">An award-winning workplace</span></h3> <p><span data-contrast="none">You can be a part of our ‘Great Place to Work’ – with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all. </span><a href="https://www.baringa.com/en/impact/awards/"><span data-contrast="none">Click here</span></a><span data-contrast="none"> to see some of our recent awards and how we’ve achieved this.</span> </p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Using business as a force for good.</span> </span></h3> <p><span data-contrast="none">We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559738":200,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) agenda is about giving back to the communities in which we live and work by sharing our skills, talent and time. In essence, we aim to empower and encourage everyone in the firm to contribute to the things we care about, and support registered charities and organisations with a clear social or environmental purpose to increase the positive impact they can have.</span></p> <p> </p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><span style="color: rgb(208, 0, 111); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;" data-teams="true">Join us</span></h3> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;" data-teams="true">All applications received will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We never rely solely on automated screening or AI tools to make hiring decisions. Your application will be considered for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, nationality, disability, age, faith or social background. We do not filter applications by university background and encourage those who have taken alternative educational and career paths to apply. We would like to actively encourage applications from those who identify with less represented and minority groups. We operate an inclusive recruitment process, ensuring reasonable adjustments where needed. Please contact a member of our Recruitment Team to discuss further.</span></p> <p> </p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(208, 0, 111); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;" data-teams="true">Baringa Privacy Notices</span></h3> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>For UK & EU</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Your personal data will be retained by Baringa for up to two years, in accordance with our <a href="https://www.baringa.com/globalassets/careers/dp-004-ukrpn---uk-recruitment-privacy-notice-pdf.pdf">UK Recruitment Privacy Notice / </a><a href="https://www.baringa.com/globalassets/careers/dp-005-eurpn---eu-recruitment-privacy-notice-pdf.pdf">EU Recruitment Privacy Notice</a>, to evaluate your application and meet our legal and reporting obligations. In line with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to request access to, rectification, or erasure (subject to legal limitations) of your personal data. For more information, please contact us at <a ---------- <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>For the USA</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Your personal data may be retained by Baringa for up to two years, as outlined in our <a href="https://www.baringa.com/globalassets/careers/dp-007-nerpn-amer--apac-recruitment-privacy-notice-word.pdf">Recruitment Privacy Notice (AMER & APAC)</a>, to support the recruitment process and internal reporting requirements. This could include experience across supply chain transformation, S&OP, planning and forecasting, ERP-enabled transformation, or operating model design and implementation.</p> <p>This is a broad transformation leadership role rather than a position focused on a single functional specialism. The right person will combine strong consulting and programme leadership capabilities with the commercial confidence to lead client relationships, manage complex engagements, and identify opportunities to deepen and grow existing accounts.</p> <p>Candidates may have built their career entirely within consulting or combined consulting with relevant industry experience. However, substantial consulting experience and a clear understanding of how to lead clients through complex transformation are essential.</p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);">What we are looking for</span></h3> <p>You will be a pragmatic transformation leader who is comfortable moving between strategic thinking and the realities of implementation. You will understand what it takes to mobilise and deliver complex programmes, engage senior client stakeholders, and create alignment across business and technology teams.</p> <p>You do not need to be a pure business development or new-logo origination specialist. However, you must be comfortable owning senior client relationships, leading the day-to-day development of accounts, and identifying opportunities to broaden our impact with existing clients.</p> <p>You will also bring enough depth in consumer products or retail to understand the commercial and operational context in which clients are transforming, while retaining the breadth to work across different types of transformation challenge.</p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What you will be doing</span></span></h3> <ul> <li>Lead complex transformation engagements for consumer products and retail clients, taking responsibility for successful delivery from initial design through to implementation.</li> <li>Help clients shape and deliver transformation across areas such as supply chain, S&OP, business planning, forecasting, ERP implementation, and operating model effectiveness.</li> <li>Translate strategic objectives into practical transformation roadmaps, delivery plans, governance structures, and measurable business outcomes.</li> <li>Lead the day-to-day management of major client accounts and engagements, building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders.</li> <li>Act as a confident and credible account leader who can strengthen client relationships, identify emerging needs, and grow existing accounts.</li> <li>Oversee complex programmes involving multiple workstreams, business functions, technology platforms, geographies, and stakeholder groups.</li> <li>Work across business and technology teams to ensure that transformation programmes deliver sustainable operational improvements rather than standalone systems or process changes.</li> <li>Advise clients on the organisational, process, capability, data, and technology changes required to deliver successful transformation.</li> <li>Provide clear leadership to multidisciplinary project teams, creating an environment in which consultants can perform effectively and develop their capabilities.</li> <li>Manage programme risks, dependencies, budgets, resources, governance, and senior stakeholder expectations.</li> <li>Support business development activity through proposal development, solution design, client presentations, and the expansion of existing relationships.</li> <li>Contribute to the continued development of our Consumer Products & Retail practice, including its propositions, delivery capabilities, market profile, and people.</li> </ul> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Your skills and experience</span></span></h3> <ul> <li>Significant experience within consulting, with a strong track record of leading complex transformation engagements for consumer products or retail clients.</li> <li>Experience operating at Senior Manager, Director, or an equivalent level within a recognised consulting organisation.</li> <li>Demonstrable expertise in one or more of the following areas:</li> <ul> <li>Supply chain transformation</li> <li>Sales and operations planning, or S&OP</li> <li>Demand, supply, or integrated business planning</li> <li>Forecasting and planning transformation</li> <li>ERP-enabled business transformation</li> <li>Operating model design and implementation</li> <li>Complex programme leadership</li> </ul> <li>Experience leading major transformation programmes from strategy and design through to implementation and business adoption.</li> <li>A strong understanding of how business processes, operating models, data, technology, organisation design, and change management come together within a successful transformation.</li> <li>Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary consulting teams and manage multiple workstreams within complex client environments.</li> <li>Strong client engagement and account management skills, with the confidence to work with senior client stakeholders and manage important day-to-day relationships.</li> <li>Evidence of growing or expanding existing client accounts by identifying additional client needs and converting them into relevant opportunities.</li> <li>Strong commercial judgement, including experience managing engagement economics, delivery quality, scope, risk, and client expectations.</li> <li>The ability to communicate complex transformation topics clearly and credibly to both business and technology stakeholders.</li> <li>Excellent problem-solving, facilitation, influencing, and stakeholder management capabilities.</li> <li>A collaborative leadership style and a strong commitment to coaching and developing consulting talent.</li> <li>Industry experience gained before, during, or after a consulting career would be valuable, but candidates must bring substantial and current consulting capability.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What a career at Baringa will give you</span> </span></h2> <h3><br><span title: Talent Lead
description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role ElevenLabs has grown to over 1,000 in three years, and the rate of growth is not slowing down. As Talent Lead, you will be in charge of one of the most visible and impactful functions in the company: hundreds of hires a quarter across Research, Engineering, GTM and Operations, in one of the most competitive talent markets in history. You’ll move Talent from a high-volume recruiting engine to a strategic partner that tells leaders what is achievable, and you’ll rebuild how we hire using the same AI products we make. You'll run the entire Talent team (currently 20 - 30 recruiters, sourcers, and talent operations) across verticals, setting the strategy, building the systems, and staying hands-on where it matters. You'll report directly to the Operations Lead and be a close partner to the People team. This isn't a pure executive role - we want someone who still loves the craft of recruiting and can model what great looks like for the team around them. The right person has done this before at scale - at a company that grew fast and hired harder. Your team will look to you not just for direction, but as someone they can genuinely learn from. This will be an opportunity to shape the direction of Talent at ElevenLab; where we go, how we get there and who we get there with. If you want to shape the future of the Talent industry by building industry-defining playbooks using the latest technology and AI solutions, whilst building an expert team - this might be your best fit yet. In this role you will: Lead the full talent function across Research, GTM, Engineering & Product, and G&A hiring - setting strategy, managing team performance, building a recruiter capacity engine, and driving outcomes across all verticals. Shape Talent Operations: ATS (Ashby) configuration, headcount tracking, hiring velocity metrics, and recruiter tooling - ensuring the function runs with precision and minimal friction. Identify innovative ways of approaching Talent: design the next-gen Talent org structure, envision how Talent processes can be agentified and work with the team to build ElevenLabs products throughout. Act as a strategic partner to department heads and hiring managers, bringing market intelligence, pipeline health visibility, and honest counsel on what it takes to consistently win the best people in the market. Build and maintain a strong talent brand through thoughtful candidate experience, community engagement, building a Talent events program and creative sourcing strategies. Coach and develop a team of recruiters, establishing clear standards for quality of hire, speed, and candidate experience. Partner with functional leaders across Research, Engineering, GTM, and Operations - acting as a trusted advisor who can challenge, align, and mobilize leaders around talent priorities and workforce strategy. We’re moving quickly on this search. Applications close on 13 November 2026, and we’ll start reviewing right away, so we’d encourage you to apply early. Requirements Proven track record leading large TA functions at high-growth companies, with direct experience filling hundreds of roles per year across multiple functions and geographies. Hands-on recruiting instincts - comfortable being in the weeds on critical searches, not just managing from a distance. Strong people leader who builds, develops, and retains recruiting talent. Sharp on process: able to design and iterate on systems, tooling, and workflows that make a team of 20–30 perform at a high level with AI. Close collaborator with People, Finance, and business leaders - comfortable operating at the intersection of headcount planning, compensation, and hiring strategy. Held a high bar for quality of hire while hitting aggressive volume, with the metrics to show it. Advised founders and executive suite on workforce planning, and changed a plan with your judgment. Worked with Finance, People and RevOps on headcount planning, capacity modelling, compensation and offer strategy. description: <p> </p> <p><strong>ABOUT NEXGEN CLOUD</strong></p> <p>NexGen Cloud is a fast-growing GPU cloud and AI infrastructure business. Powered by 100% renewable energy and NVIDIA architecture, Hyperstack gives teams from AI startups to enterprise the compute they need, without the cost or complexity of legacy cloud.</p> <p>We move fast, solve hard problems, and build things that matter. You’ll report to our Chief Product & Technology Officer and lead a team of three Product Engineers, based in London or Australia.</p> <p>This is a role for someone who’s comfortable shaping loosely defined problems into clear priorities, makes trade-offs and explains them, and takes accountability for adoption and outcomes, not just a delivery plan.</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING</strong></p> <p>Rather than a checklist, here’s what success in this role actually looks like:</p> <ul> <li>Own and drive the product vision and roadmap for the new customer platform, AI Studio and ML products, prioritising ruthlessly across customer needs, commercial goals and engineering capacity.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with Engineering, Infrastructure, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing and Security, so products are buildable, supportable, compliant and ready to sell at launch.</li> <li>Run regular discovery with customers and prospects to understand how they build, train, fine-tune and deploy models, and turn what you learn into clear problem statements, user stories and acceptance criteria.</li> <li>Define what a minimum useful release looks like for each product, and sequence delivery so customers get value early rather than at the end of a long build.</li> <li>Lead your team from idea to release: run the planning and delivery cadence, keep the backlog actionable, and remove blockers along the way.</li> <li>Line-manage and develop three Product Engineers, and help hire and build a team that owns problems end to end.</li> <li>Define and track adoption, activation, usage and retention metrics, and use them, alongside the competitive landscape, to decide what to do next.</li> </ul> <p><strong>ABOUT YOU</strong></p> <p>We care more about how you think and work than a perfect CV. platforms or infrastructure.</li> <li>A track record of taking a new product from early concept through to launch and adoption.</li> <li>Experience line-managing or directly leading a small team, including performance and development conversations.</li> <li>Enough technical depth to work credibly with engineers on APIs, platform architecture and infrastructure trade-offs.</li> <li>A working understanding of how AI and ML teams build, train and deploy models, and the tooling they rely on.</li> <li>Strong discovery and prioritisation skills, with evidence of turning customer research into roadmap decisions.</li> </ul> <p><em>Nice to Have:</em></p> <ul> <li>Product experience with GPU cloud, AI/ML platforms, MLOps tooling, or model serving and fine-tuning products.</li> <li>A hands-on technical background, such as software or ML engineering, and conceptual familiarity with Kubernetes, containers and the NVIDIA GPU ecosystem.</li> <li>Experience with usage-based pricing models and working across distributed teams in multiple time zones.</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHAT WE OFFER</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive salary and annual discretionary bonus scheme</li> <li>Employee wellbeing benefits</li> <li>25 days holiday, plus public holidays</li> <li>Private Medical Insurance</li> <li>Enhanced Pension Scheme</li> <li>Flexible working arrangements (remote or hybrid, depending on role and location)</li> <li>Real ownership and autonomy — the trust to take initiative and experiment</li> <li>Visible, meaningful impact as we scale</li> <li>Clear career progression in a high-growth company</li> <li>A collaborative, international culture built on trust, transparency, and ownership</li> <li>The chance to help shape NexGen Cloud’s team, culture, and future</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHY APPLY</strong></p> <p>We welcome applications from all backgrounds. If you enjoy solving complex infrastructure problems and want to build something meaningful at scale, we’d like to hear from you.</p> <p><strong>MORE INFORMATION</strong></p> <p>Visit our <a href="https://www.nexgencloud.com/careers">careers page</a> to learn more about us or follow us on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/nexgen-cloud">LinkedIn</a> and <a href="https://x.com/CloudNexgen">X</a> to learn more about our journey and keep up with our latest news and releases.</p> <p> </p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

We work alongside our first line credit teams who design the products, decide who to lend to, set underwriting policy, identify customers who need help, manage the portfolio and report and measure credit risk.</p> <p>Within CIF, we are scaling up our Forecasting modelling and execution team to support the enhancement of modelling standards across Finance. This will expand to hands-on delivery of model developments, where appropriate. </p> <p>Strong data and analytical skills are a must, as is experience in financial modelling and coding (Python and SQL preferred). SQL and Python are our desired coding languages but experience in SAS/R will be considered. A data visualisation tool (such as Streamlit or Looker) is a plus</li> <li>You can convey problems and solutions using clear and simple language, both written and verbal (see <a href="https://monzo.com/tone-of-voice/">Monzo’s tone of voice</a> guide). This is particularly important for communicating complex issues and priorities to non-experts</li> <li>You're impact driven and eager to have a real positive impact on the company, our products, our users and your team-mates</li> <li>You have a self-starter mindset<em>;</em> you proactively identify issues and opportunities and tackle them without being told to do so</li> <li>You're a team player<em> </em>whom your colleagues can rely on</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ol> <li>Initial call with a member of the Forecasting team</li> <li>Technical modelling interview </li> <li>Values and collaboration behavioural interview</li> <li>A live case study problem solving interview</li> </ol> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £79,000 to £106,800 + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">benefits</a>  </p> <p>📍 London (one day a week)</p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">here</a></p> <p> </p> <p><span class="notion-enable-hover" data-token-index="0">#LI-JH1</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK.
